comments.value: I agree 100%. I dont understand why we need to see it while not talking

> unless you are muted
If I'm muted I don't want to see it too. Without disabling whole hud (invites) :/
agree hate seeing muted icon althe time but i dont want to miss invites
I know its there to show that the mic is indeed unmuted but yeah in vr it does break immersion quite a lot imo. More hud options would be very nice.
You could just disable it under the UI options via the ingame menu.
@{5ae76c0b9582a14da86a5c52|full_name}: But then you disable the whole UI and won't see notifications
Either this, or make the icon when not talking a lot more transparent. Sometimes it's actually so visible and bright in some darker maps that I think it's on and transmitting audio.
The bug with the mic icon staying on longer than after you're done talking has been in the game for months upon months now, would be nice if it was fixed.
How about just putting in a slider a slider instead that allows the user to adjust how transparent it is? I personally want to see that mic sign. I don’t see it as immersion breaking.
@{5cd4a07de608892a431932a2|full_name}: We definetly need more personalization of this kind

We added this feature on 21 August 2023!

https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/vrchat-202332

We wanted to ensure the microphone icon wasn't causing burn-in issues on OLED displays. But we're happy that it'll improve your immersion, too! Thank you for the request.

details: The mic icon is intrusive and breaks immersion. It should not be visible unless you are muted or transmitting audio.
title: Make Mic HUD Icon Invisible Until You Talk

voters.name: Nathaniel Eliab De Los Santos Jimenez
